
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19201173" title="发布于 2025-11-07 23:54">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">最新版uni-app+vue3+uv-ui跨端仿携程酒店预订模板【H5+小程序+App端】</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(255, 170, 0, 1)">原创新作<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">uniapp+vue3+pinia2+uv-ui</span>跨端<strong>仿携程app</strong>旅行预约酒店系统。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>uni-vue3-hotel</strong>：基于<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">vite5+uniapp+vue3 setup+pinia2+uni-ui</span>搭建跨端旅行酒店预订程序。集合了<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 204, 255, 1)">酒店首页、酒店预订搜索、列表/详情、订单、聊天客服消息、我的</span>等功能模块。支持编译运行<strong>web+小程序+app端</strong>。</span></p>
<h3>运行三端效果</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">编译运行到<strong>h5+小程序+app端</strong>效果如下：</span></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-1-2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107220800802-1386930917.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>使用技术</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：HbuilderX 4.84</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">技术框架：uni-app+vite5+vue3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia2</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">组件库：uni-ui+uv-ui（uniapp+vue3组件库）</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">弹框组件：uv3-popup（基于uniapp+vue3多端弹窗组件）</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">自定义组件：uv3-navbar导航条+uv3-tabbar菜单栏</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">缓存技术：pinia-plugin-unistorage</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持运行：web+小程序+app端</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="未标题0-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107221123611-1011653224.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107221424813-2127632649.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">uniapp-vue3-trip采用vue3 setup语法编码，支持运行到<strong>web+小程序+app端</strong>，且三端效果基本保持一致。</span></p>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107221634650-1543652943.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107221704642-1278197843.gif" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="360截图20251106234757798" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107221905169-2011257360.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>入口配置文件</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createSSRApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入pinia状态管理</span>
import pinia from '@/pinia'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createApp() {
  const app </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createSSRApp(App)
  app.use(pinia)
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    app,
    pinia
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>

  })
  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>

    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否显示自定义tabbar</span>

  })
  
  const handleChange </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (index) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(index </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">==</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">2</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      uni.showToast({
        icon: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">none</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        title: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">自定义功能</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      })
    }
  }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<h3>uni-app+vue3自定义导航条+tabbar栏</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107225130456-102367861.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231046364-1240389001.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231210431-1537206202.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231320536-1108076139.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231412783-360124530.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231558684-1368955572.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">自定义navbar导航栏和tabbar菜单栏组件在components目录下。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107231759259-328392536.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>navbar组件支持如下参数</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const props =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> defineProps({
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否是自定义导航</span>
  custom: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否显示返回</span>
  back: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标题</span>
  title: { type: [String, Number], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标题颜色</span>
  color: { type: String, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: '#fff'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 背景色</span>
  bgcolor: { type: String, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: '#07c160'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标题字体大小</span>
  size: { type: String, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标题是否居中</span>
  center: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否搜索</span>
  search: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否固定</span>
  fixed: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否背景透明</span>
  transparent: { type: [Boolean, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置层级</span>
  zIndex: { type: [Number, String], <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: '2023'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义iconfont字体图标库前缀</span>
  customPrefix: { type: String, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>: 'uv3trip-icon'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义样式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  customStyle: String,
})</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107232037764-473469231.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107232131018-1918384319.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">如上图：底部tabbar组件采用背景<strong>高斯模糊毛玻璃</strong>效果。</span></p>
<p><strong>tabbar组件支持如下参数</strong></p>

<h3>uni-app+vue3预约酒店模板</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107232800634-2015111682.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">如上图：酒店预订模块封装成booking.vue组件。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107233102420-339845490.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">酒店预订日期选择插件，采用底部弹窗+uv-ui日历组件实现功能。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107233327062-889095202.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 日历 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uv3-popup
  </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-model</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isVisibleCalendar"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="选择日期"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  position</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="bottom"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  round
  xclose
  xposition</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="left"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  :customStyle</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'overflow': 'hidden'}"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  @open</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="showCalendar=true"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  @close</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="showCalendar=false"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uv-calendars
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="showCalendar"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="calendarRef"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    mode</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="range"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    insert
    color</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="#ffaa00"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :startDate</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="startDate"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :endDate</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="endDate"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :date</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="rangeDate"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :selected</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="dingDate"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="选择日期"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    start-text</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="入住"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    end-text</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="离店"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    @change</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleCalendarChange"</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uv3-popup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 日期参数
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
const isVisibleCalendar </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
const showCalendar </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
const calendarRef </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
const nightNum </span>= ref(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 限制日期选择范围-开始日期</span>
const startDate = ref(getDate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date()).fullDate)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 限制日期选择范围-结束日期</span>
const endDate = ref(getDate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 90<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义默认选中日期，不传默认为今天。mode="multiple"或mode="range"时，该值为数组</span>
const rangeDate = ref([getDate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date()).fullDate, getDate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate])
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打点，期待格式[{date: '2019-06-27', info: '签到', disable: false}]</span>
const dingDate =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref([
  {
    date: getDate(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate,
    info: </span>'已预订'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    infoColor: </span>'#ffaa00'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    badge: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  {
    date: getDate(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate,
    info: </span>'已满'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    disable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  },
  {
    date: getDate(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate,
    info: </span>'优惠'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    infoColor: </span>'#19be6b'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    topinfo: </span>'￥99'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    topinfoColor: </span>'#19be6b'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  {
    date: getDate(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Date(), 7<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).fullDate,
    info: </span>'有空房'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    infoColor: </span>'#09f'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  },
])</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>uni-app+vue3客服消息模块</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107233642754-1974830840.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;&nbsp;<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251107233857056-964361757.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">项目中加入了聊天消息模块。可以去看看之前开发的一款<strong>uniapp+vue3仿微信app聊天</strong>项目。</span></p>
